name: Geological Engineering Lab
description: Geological Maps, Geological Mapping – contouring, topo sheets, Geological sections, outcrops, apparent and true dips, three-point problems, depth and thickness problems, joints, fault displacement measurement, measurement of attitude of outcrops, geological compass, stereonet & kinematic analysis, Megascopic identification & characterization of minerals and rocks, Engineering properties of rocks and measurements: compressive and tensile strength, Specimen preparation, Guided tour through representative geological formations, and structures.
